1  HON'BLE ABDUL SHAHID, J.
1. Heard Sri M.K. Madan and Sri Sandeep Kumar Rai, learned counsel for the revisionist, Sri Shriprakash Dwivedi, learned counsel for opposite party no. 2 and learned A.G.A. for the State-respondent.
2. Learned counsel for revisionist has submitted that the matter pertains to the dispute between the revisionist and opposite party No.2 about their personal grudge.

Therefore, two FIRs have been lodged by opposite party no. 2, i.e. case crime no. 66 of 2024 dated 24.4.2024 and another FIR which is the subject matter of the instant revision i.e. case crime no. 103 of 2024 dated 9.6.2024 in respect of an incident alleged to have occurred on 24.12.2021.
3. Learned counsel for both the parties have agreed to end the dispute between themselves amicably.
4. Considering the aforesaid, let an amount of Rs.35,000/- be deposited by the revisionist before the Mediation and Conciliation Centre, High Court, Allahabad within a period of two weeks from today.

5. The parties concerned shall appear before the Mediation Center of this Court on 30.10.2025 i.e.
the date mutually agreed by the learned counsels for the parties.
6. On the first appearance of opposite party no.2 before the Mediation Center, an amount of Rs.30,000/- would be released in her favour by the Mediation Center of this Court.
7. Mediation Center of this Court would make an endeavour to submit its report within a period three months.

8. List after three months before the appropriate Court showing the name of Sri Shriprakash Dwivedi as counsel for opposite parties.
9.

Meanwhile, the operation and execution of the impugned order dated 6.8.2025 passed by the learned Additional District & Sessions Judge, F.T.C.-First, Varanasi, in Sessions Trial No. 475 of 2025, arising out of case crime no. 103 of 2024, under Sections 328, 376, 506 IPC, Police Station Chitaipur, District Varanasi is hereby stayed.
